restrictions: Use only 48-byte messages BE_32(x)||BE_16(y), so each complete fixed-IV sha256-r31 hash is exactly one selected-round compression of one padded block, with full feed-forward and the full 256-bit digest.
Draw two fresh independent uniform 256-bit RAM words for each of exactly q = 2^128 messages; deterministic seed expansion is not a substitute.

Group equal digests with a two-pass stable LSD counting sort on 128-bit digest halves (2^128 counters), scan adjacent records, require distinct messages, and verify a returned pair by complete re-hashing.

Price one selected compression at 1 and every other primitive word operation at 1/2140 (collision-frontier-v5); the ordinary-operation budget also charges one instruction fetch per executed instruction.
Preprocessing is inside total time; nonuniform_advice_log2_bytes=0 is a one-byte upper bound with zero actual advice.
This is an unconditional analytic construction with no heuristics, experiments, computed witness, hidden precomputed search, or claimed improvement over the nominal reference 128.
